purpose: Rollback oracle immediately before Prometeo begins the local-first IndexedDB persistence migration.

authority.rule: Served/current is not the same as Human Accepted. This baseline freezes source and behavior for rollback only.

persistence_before_migration.note: Do not delete or rewrite these keys during the first IndexedDB migration. Migration must be additive, idempotent and rollback-safe.

behavior_semantics_to_preserve: X always means an undesired event.
Solid fill always means an explicitly recorded positive event.
Dot is reserved for an intermediate warning such as craving.
Blank on negative-event trackers is baseline/no negative event after activation.
Blank on positive Extras is neutral/unmarked, never failure.
Trajectory is derived from logs and is never a second source of truth.
The entire tracker label rail toggles its graph; the chevron is not an exclusive hit target.

next_frontier.goal: Introduce PrometeoDB on IndexedDB without changing the served UI or losing any localStorage history.
next_frontier.migration_rule: Freeze -> introduce storage runtime -> verify -> migrate habits idempotently -> dual-read during cutover -> only then retire legacy ownership.
